Title: Make Complex Heatmaps
Authors@R:
person("Zuguang", "Gu", email = "guzuguang@suat-sz.edu.cn", role = c("aut", "cre"),
comment = c('ORCID'="0000-0002-7395-8709"))
Description:
Complex heatmaps are efficient to visualize associations
between different sources of data sets and reveal potential
patterns. Here the ComplexHeatmap package provides a highly
flexible way to arrange multiple heatmaps and supports various
annotation graphics.
Author: Zuguang Gu [aut, cre] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7395-8709>)
